notes: The version on the credit strip no longer has its last character clipped off.
The panel now comes up painted: seat colours and the version line were being applied before the layout existed, which did nothing and said nothing.
The on-screen panel now travels inside the script instead of being fetched separately, so an update can no longer install one half of the tool.
It arrives with the update it belongs to, every time, rather than sometimes not at all.
The on-screen panel now actually arrives with the update. The object was reloading before the layout had finished being written.
Fixed updating itself: a release with an on-screen panel stopped halfway with an error and left the panel on the old layout.
